data.long_meaning: The name Kahlilah is derived from the Arabic word khalil, meaning 'friend'. This name is a reminder of the close relationship between the believer and Allah. It is a name of great spiritual significance in Islam and is often given to girls to encourage a strong connection with their Creator. The name Kahlilah carries the meaning “Friend of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kahlilah usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
